papers.title: Three-dimensional seismic analysis based on FE modeling using 3-D survey incorporating spatial variability of stiffness
papers.abstract: Abstract Japan is one of the most earthquake-prone countries in the world, where a significant portion of disaster-related losses can be attributed to structural collapses. Thus, the inspection of geo-structures related to these earthquakes is important. Although conventional inspections are conducted by two-dimensional analyses, the actual behaviors of the structures are affected three-dimensionally. This has led to an increase in the demand for three-dimensional analyses. A three-dimensional survey has recently been developed, using an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which has made the rebuilding of the three-dimensional shape of structures easier. Despite the development of this technique, it has not been adopted for the design of geo-structures. In this study, for the purpose of incorporating the three-dimensional survey technique into the design of geo-structures, an earth-fill dam is surveyed three-dimensionally by a drone, and a three-dimensional finite element model (FEM model) of the dam is made based on the survey results and the newly developed modeling approach. The spatial distribution of the ground stiffness is estimated based on screw weight sounding (SWS) test results, and then applied to the 3-D FEM modeling. Gaussian process regression (GPR), which serves as a geostatistical interpolation framework to transform sparse field measurements into continuous three-dimensional material property distributions for the FEM model, is employed for the spatial interpolation of the ground stiffness. Finally, the FEM model is applied to a seismic response analysis, and the locations of high acceleration and high shear stress inside the earth-fill dam are identified.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将高斯过程回归用于地震岩土工程三维有限元建模，与用户关注的FEA代理模型、约束优化和不确定性量化方向仅有方法层面的弱关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not develop a surrogate model, does not perform constraint or multi-objective optimization, and does not address implant or biomechanics design; it only uses GPR for geostatistical interpolation of stiffness in a geotechnical seismic FEM analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统二维分析难以反映土石坝等岩土结构在地震下的真实三维行为。
summary_zh.method: 用无人机三维测量重建土石坝几何，结合SWS试验与高斯过程回归插值空间刚度，建立三维有限元模型。
summary_zh.result: 识别出坝体内部高加速度与高剪应力的位置，验证了三维建模流程的可行性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于单一土石坝的数值模拟案例，无实验或实测地震响应验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional two-dimensional inspections fail to capture the three-dimensional seismic behavior of geotechnical structures such as earth-fill dams.
summary_en.method: A UAV-based three-dimensional survey is combined with screw weight sounding data and Gaussian process regression to interpolate spatially varying ground stiffness into a three-dimensional finite element model.
summary_en.result: The model identifies regions of elevated acceleration and shear stress within the dam during seismic loading.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to a single numerical simulation case of an earth-fill dam without experimental or field seismic response data.

papers.title: Pelvic tilt, impingement simulation, and the limits of static planning in robotic total hip arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, London, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文讨论机器人全髋关节置换中骨盆倾斜与撞击模拟的静态规划局限，不涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或骨-假体界面力学。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses pelvic tilt and impingement simulation in robotic THA planning, with no femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, contact/friction modeling, or finite element analysis of the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨骨盆倾斜对机器人全髋关节置换静态规划准确性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 结合撞击模拟分析骨盆倾斜下静态术前规划的局限性。
summary_zh.result: 静态规划难以充分反映动态骨盆倾斜导致的撞击风险。
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟分析，无实验或临床力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To examine how pelvic tilt undermines the reliability of static preoperative planning in robotic total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Impingement simulation is used to assess the limitations of static planning under varying pelvic tilt conditions.
summary_en.result: Static planning fails to capture dynamic pelvic tilt effects that contribute to impingement risk.
summary_en.validation: Simulation-based analysis without experimental or clinical mechanical validation.

papers.title: Cascaded machine learning-based neural Model Predictive Control for real-time thermal management of a sCO2 serial coaxial all-glass evacuated solar collector
concepts: Thermal management of electronic devices and systems

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文将神经网络MPC用于太阳能集热器热管理，属于控制/热工领域，与用户的FEA代理模型、植入物力学或生物打印方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant/biomechanics context, no RL world model for engineering design; it is a thermal control application with no structural mechanics or biomedical relevance.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升sCO2太阳能集热器实时热管理的控制精度与响应速度。
summary_zh.method: 采用级联机器学习神经网络构建模型预测控制器进行温度调控。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真工况下实现了集热器热性能的实时优化控制。
summary_zh.validation: 基于热工仿真案例验证控制策略。

summary_en.motivation: To improve real-time thermal management and control accuracy for a sCO2 serial coaxial all-glass evacuated solar collector.
summary_en.method: A cascaded machine-learning neural network is embedded within a model predictive control framework for temperature regulation.
summary_en.result: The controller achieves improved real-time thermal performance in the simulated collector operation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through thermal simulation case studies rather than physical experiments.

key_terms.zh: 超临界二氧化碳太阳能集热器

papers.title: Proportional-integral adaptive relaxed-set robust model predictive control for range-extender energy management in extended-range electric vehicles

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文将鲁棒模型预测控制用于增程式电动车能量管理，属于控制方法在车辆工程中的应用，与用户关注的工程仿真代理模型、FEA或植入物力学无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses vehicle energy management control with no surrogate modeling, no FEA/FEM data, no biomechanics or implant design context, and no world-model or RL methodology relevant to engineering simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 增程式电动车能量管理需在不确定性下保持鲁棒与高效。
summary_zh.method: 提出比例-积分自适应松弛集鲁棒模型预测控制策略。
summary_zh.result: 在增程器能量分配中改善了鲁棒性与燃油经济性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于车辆仿真工况进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Energy management in extended-range electric vehicles must remain robust under model and demand uncertainties.
summary_en.method: A proportional-integral adaptive relaxed-set robust model predictive control scheme is formulated for range-extender power allocation.
summary_en.result: The controller improves robustness and fuel economy relative to baseline strategies in the studied scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validation is carried out through numerical vehicle simulation case studies.
